clues.text: In the wilderness, God gave Israel bread for two days on the sixth day so they could rest on this one.
In the commands God spoke at Sinai, Israel was told to remember this day by keeping it holy.
While Israel was in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on this day and was stoned.
Nehemiah had Jerusalem's gates shut at evening so merchants could not bring their loads in on this day.
Pharisees complained when the disciples of Jesus picked heads of grain in the fields on this day.
A synagogue leader was indignant when Jesus healed a woman bent over for eighteen years on this day.
When this day was over, Mary Magdalene and Salome bought spices to anoint the body of Jesus.
